bioconda.name: prform
bioconda.summary: Predict programmed ribosomal frameshift (PRF) sites in RNA sequences.
bioconda.description:
prform scores every nucleotide of an RNA sequence for the probability
of a -1 or +1 ribosomal frameshift. A 1D residual network with a 10 kb
receptive field, plus a calibrated probability mapping, are bundled
with the package.

commands: python -c "from prform import PRFormPredictor; PRFormPredictor(model='10k', device='cpu'); PRFormPredictor(model='2k', device='cpu')"
